_comment: Tier-1 mcp_tool source preset for lakekeeper-mcp (AU-KG.ingest.mcp-tool-connector). Syncs the Lakekeeper warehouse inventory into the KG via the lakekeeper-mcp MCP server. lakekeeper_list_warehouses takes no required arguments (project_id is an optional filter, default empty = all projects) and returns a flat {warehouses: [...], count} envelope -- the only lakekeeper_* tool with zero required parameters, so the only one a scheduled sweep can call unattended. Namespaces/tables/snapshots/schema-versions each require a parent namespace/table name the sync pipeline has no way to supply on its own; those stay reachable only through direct tool calls, not this preset. Contributed presets win over the central MCP_TOOL_PRESETS.
